page_title: EMP 3-4 SAS | Empoli v Sassuolo 26/11/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' That's all for today as the game is over.
90+5' The linesman raises his flag as one of the players from Empoli was in an offside position.
90+3' The manager makes a subsitution with Marcus Pedersen (Sassuolo) coming on for Domenico Berardi.
90+2' Alberto Grassi (Empoli) sees a yellow card. He should be more careful because one more challenge like that could result in a red card.
90+2' 3 - 4 Domenico Berardi (Sassuolo) converts a killer cross with a strong and precise shot that goes across the goal and past the goalkeeper.
90+1' Simone Sozza shows a yellow card to Emmanuel Gyasi (Empoli) for his blatant foul.
90' 5 additional min. will be played.
88' The Empoli players halt their celebrations as referee Simone Sozza makes the VAR signal to review the goal, most likely to ascertain if there was an offside in the build-up play.
86' 3 - 3 OWN GOAL! Matias Vina (Sassuolo) scores an unlucky own goal after he deflected a shot which went into his own net! 3:3.
86' Emmanuel Gyasi (Empoli) gets a shot from the edge of the box, but it crashes against the crossbar!
79' A substitution has been made. Youssef Maleh goes off and Emmanuel Gyasi (Empoli) comes on.
79' Substitution. Mattia Destro (Empoli) has come on for Nicolo Cambiaghi.
79' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Kristian Thorstvedt trots off the pitch and is replaced by Nedim Bajrami (Sassuolo).
78' Alessio Dionisi prepares a substitution. Armand Lauriente is replaced by Samu Castillejo (Sassuolo).
78' Substitution. Andrea Pinamonti is replaced by Samuele Mulattieri (Sassuolo).

75' A defence-splitting pass is taken in his stride by Viktor Kovalenko (Empoli) in the box. Without even looking up he drills a shot towards the right side of the goal, but Andrea Consigli pulls off a brilliant save.
72' Sassuolo win a corner.
71' The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Empoli.
71' Substitution. Matteo Cancellieri makes way for Daniel Maldini (Empoli).
70' Substitution. Jacopo Fazzini leaves the pitch and is replaced by Viktor Kovalenko (Empoli).
70' Aurelio Andreazzoli has decided to make a change. Alberto Grassi (Empoli) replaces Filippo Ranocchia.
69' Empoli get a corner.
66' 2 - 3 GOAL! That’s a great strike from the spot by Domenico Berardi (Sassuolo) low into the right of the net, giving goalkeeper Etrit Berisha no chance!
66' Domenico Berardi (Sassuolo) is heading towards the penalty spot to take it.
65' Here comes the VAR decision: PENALTY to Sassuolo!
63' There's a break in play and referee Simone Sozza must have got a signal in his ear as he indicates he will check that earlier penalty claim by Sassuolo using VAR. This could be interesting!
63' Matteo Cancellieri (Empoli) trips an opponent with a slide tackle. Simone Sozza stops the game and he could give him a card, but eventually decides on just a warning.
62' Some great controlled play and passing from Empoli. They are increasing their possession of the ball and trying to open up the opposition's defence to hit them swiftly on the break.
57' Sassuolo force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.
55' Mattia Viti (Sassuolo) is being substituted because of an injury. Alessio Dionisi sends Matias Vina on the pitch.
53' Mattia Viti (Sassuolo) is having a really tough time right now. We are about to find out how serious his injury is.
50' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Domenico Berardi (Sassuolo) was quite harsh and Simone Sozza didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
50' Domenico Berardi (Sassuolo) gives away a foul for a fierce tackle on an opponent.
49' Armand Lauriente (Sassuolo) did his best to latch on to a crossfield pass, but it was too long and it goes out of play.
46' Jacopo Fazzini (Empoli) tries to send a pass but it's blocked.
46' The whistle blows and Simone Sozza starts the second half.
45+2' The end of the first half.
45+1' Marcus Pedersen (Sassuolo) takes a short corner kick.
45' The fourth official shows 1 min. of added time.
44' Simone Sozza blows for a foul after Ardian Ismajli (Empoli) was too aggressive in the battle for the ball.
42' Nicolo Cambiaghi (Empoli) is heading toward the corner flag to take the set piece.

40' Matteo Cancellieri (Empoli) is obviously not following the Golden Rule: "Treat others as you want to be treated.“ He makes a bad challenge and leaves Simone Sozza with no other option than to blow for a foul.
38' The linesman makes the right call and Empoli will have a corner.
37' Matheus Henrique (Sassuolo) is shown a deserved yellow card for saying too much to the referee.
34' Armand Lauriente (Sassuolo) escapes without any punishment from the referee after using excessive force to foul his opponent.
31' Youssef Maleh (Empoli) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Simone Sozza had an easy-decision to make.

31' Youssef Maleh (Empoli) makes a reckless foul in order to win the ball from his opponent. Simone Sozza has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle. Free kick. Sassuolo will probably just try to cross the ball in from here.
30' 2 - 2 Jacopo Fazzini (Empoli) breaks through before collecting a brilliant pass and producing a precise strike to beat the goalkeeper. The ball went into the bottom right corner.
29' The current number of shots on goal is 1:4.
25' Jacopo Fazzini (Empoli) has tested the patience of referee Simone Sozza and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
24' Jacopo Fazzini (Empoli) makes a bad challenge and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
22' 1 - 2 Goal! A great cross from Jeremy Toljan finds Matheus Henrique (Sassuolo), who scores with a simple header into an empty net. 1:2.
21' Armand Lauriente (Sassuolo) attempts to find the head of one of his teammates with a promising cross into the box, but a defender outjumps the attackers and averts the threat.
20' Sassuolo win a free kick and will be able to apply some pressure on the opposition goal.
17' Empoli will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
17' Empoli take a short corner instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
12' 1 - 1 Andrea Pinamonti (Sassuolo) rose high above the defence to head the ball over the goalkeeper and inside the net.
12' Sassuolo will take a corner kick.
9' Some patient build-up play from Empoli as they look to unlock the defence.
7' Sassuolo earn a corner.
4' GOAL! That’s a great strike from the spot by Francesco Caputo (Empoli) low into the left of the net, giving goalkeeper Andrea Consigli no chance!
3' Francesco Caputo (Empoli) will take the responsibility and he is already preparing the ball.
3' Mattia Viti (Sassuolo) makes an overly-aggressive challenge and Simone Sozza blows his whistle for a foul. Empoli are awarded a penalty!
2' Mattia Viti (Sassuolo) put a cross into the box which wasn't a bad decision, but he failed to achieve what he wanted as none of his teammates managed to meet it.
1' The first half has started.
Sassuolo will kick-off.
Simone Sozza will officiate today.
